//===-- mlir-c/Interop.h - Constants for Python/C-API interop -----*- C -*-===//
//
// Part of the LLVM Project, under the Apache License v2.0 with LLVM
// Exceptions.
// See https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt for license information.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
//
// This header declares constants and helpers necessary for C-level
// interop with the MLIR Python extension module. Since the Python bindings
// are a thin wrapper around the MLIR C-API, a further C-API is not provided
// specifically for the Python extension. Instead, simple facilities are
// provided for translating between Python types and corresponding MLIR C-API
// types.
//
// This header is standalone, requiring nothing beyond normal linking against
// the Python implementation.
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#ifndef MLIR_C_BINDINGS_PYTHON_INTEROP_H
#define MLIR_C_BINDINGS_PYTHON_INTEROP_H

// We *should*, in theory, include Python.h here in order to import the correct
// definitions for what we need below, however, importing Python.h directly on
// Windows results in the enforcement of either pythonX.lib or pythonX_d.lib
// depending on the build flavor. Instead, we rely on the fact that this file
// (Interop.h) is always included AFTER pybind11 and will therefore have access
// to the definitions from Python.h in addition to having a workaround applied
// through the pybind11 headers that allows us to control which python library
// is used.
#if !defined(_MSC_VER)
#include <Python.h>
#endif

#include "mlir-c/AffineExpr.h"
#include "mlir-c/AffineMap.h"
#include "mlir-c/ExecutionEngine.h"
#include "mlir-c/IR.h"
#include "mlir-c/IntegerSet.h"
#include "mlir-c/Pass.h"
#include "mlir-c/Rewrite.h"

// The 'mlir' Python package is relocatable and supports co-existing in multiple
// projects. Each project must define its outer package prefix with this define
// in order to provide proper isolation and local name resolution.
// The default is for the upstream "import mlir" package layout.
// Note that this prefix is internally stringified, allowing it to be passed
// unquoted on the compiler command line without shell quote escaping issues.
#ifndef MLIR_PYTHON_PACKAGE_PREFIX
#define MLIR_PYTHON_PACKAGE_PREFIX mlir.
#endif

// Makes a fully-qualified name relative to the MLIR python package.
#define MLIR_PYTHON_STRINGIZE(s) #s
#define MLIR_PYTHON_STRINGIZE_ARG(arg) MLIR_PYTHON_STRINGIZE(arg)
#define MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME(local)                                       \
  MLIR_PYTHON_STRINGIZE_ARG(MLIR_PYTHON_PACKAGE_PREFIX) local

#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_AFFINE_EXPR                                        \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.AffineExpr._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_AFFINE_MAP                                         \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.AffineMap._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_ATTRIBUTE                                          \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.Attribute._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_BLOCK MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.Block._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_CONTEXT                                            \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.Context._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_DIALECT_REGISTRY                                   \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.DialectRegistry._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_EXECUTION_ENGINE                                   \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("execution_engine.ExecutionEngine._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_INTEGER_SET                                        \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.IntegerSet._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_LOCATION                                           \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.Location._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_MODULE                                             \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.Module._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_OPERATION                                          \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.Operation._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_TYPE MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.Type._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_PASS_MANAGER                                       \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("passmanager.PassManager._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_VALUE MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.Value._CAPIPtr")
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_TYPEID                                             \
  MAKE_MLIR_PYTHON_QUALNAME("ir.TypeID._CAPIPtr")

/** Attribute on MLIR Python objects that expose their C-API pointer.
 * This will be a type-specific capsule created as per one of the helpers
 * below.
 *
 * Ownership is not transferred by acquiring a capsule in this way: the
 * validity of the pointer wrapped by the capsule will be bounded by the
 * lifetime of the Python object that produced it. Only the name and pointer
 * of the capsule are set. The caller is free to set a destructor and context
 * as needed to manage anything further. */
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPI_PTR_ATTR "_CAPIPtr"

/** Attribute on MLIR Python objects that exposes a factory function for
 * constructing the corresponding Python object from a type-specific
 * capsule wrapping the C-API pointer. The signature of the function is:
 *   def _CAPICreate(capsule) -> object
 * Calling such a function implies a transfer of ownership of the object the
 * capsule wraps: after such a call, the capsule should be considered invalid,
 * and its wrapped pointer must not be destroyed.
 *
 * Only a very small number of Python objects can be created in such a fashion
 * (i.e. top-level types such as Context where the lifetime can be cleanly
 * delineated). */
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPI_FACTORY_ATTR "_CAPICreate"

/** Attribute on MLIR Python objects that expose a function for downcasting the
 * corresponding Python object to a subclass if the object is in fact a subclass
 * (Concrete or mlir_type_subclass) of ir.Type. The signature of the function
 * is: def maybe_downcast(self) -> object where the resulting object will
 * (possibly) be an instance of the subclass.
 */
#define MLIR_PYTHON_MAYBE_DOWNCAST_ATTR "maybe_downcast"

/** Attribute on main C extension module (_mlir) that corresponds to the
 * type caster registration binding. The signature of the function is:
 *   def register_type_caster(MlirTypeID mlirTypeID, *, bool replace)
 * which then takes a typeCaster (register_type_caster is meant to be used as a
 * decorator from python), and where replace indicates the typeCaster should
 * replace any existing registered type casters (such as those for upstream
 * ConcreteTypes). The interface of the typeCaster is: def type_caster(ir.Type)
 * -> SubClassTypeT where SubClassTypeT indicates the result should be a
 * subclass (inherit from) ir.Type.
 */
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPI_TYPE_CASTER_REGISTER_ATTR "register_type_caster"

/** Attribute on main C extension module (_mlir) that corresponds to the
 * value caster registration binding. The signature of the function is:
 *   def register_value_caster(MlirTypeID mlirTypeID, *, bool replace)
 * which then takes a valueCaster (register_value_caster is meant to be used as
 * a decorator, from python), and where replace indicates the valueCaster should
 * replace any existing registered value casters. The interface of the
 * valueCaster is: def value_caster(ir.Value) -> SubClassValueT where
 * SubClassValueT indicates the result should be a subclass (inherit from)
 * ir.Value.
 */
#define MLIR_PYTHON_CAPI_VALUE_CASTER_REGISTER_ATTR "register_value_caster"

/// Gets a void* from a wrapped struct. Needed because const cast is different
/// between C/C++.
#ifdef __cplusplus
#define MLIR_PYTHON_GET_WRAPPED_POINTER(object)                                \
  (const_cast<void *>((object).ptr))
#else
#define MLIR_PYTHON_GET_WRAPPED_POINTER(object) (void *)(object.ptr)
#endif

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/** Creates a capsule object encapsulating the raw C-API MlirAffineExpr. The
 * returned capsule does not extend or affect ownership of any Python objects
 * that reference the expression in any way.
 */
static inline PyObject *mlirPythonAffineExprToCapsule(MlirAffineExpr expr) {
  return PyCapsule_New(MLIR_PYTHON_GET_WRAPPED_POINTER(expr),
                       MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_AFFINE_EXPR, NULL);
}

/** Extracts an MlirAffineExpr from a capsule as produced from
 * mlirPythonAffineExprToCapsule. If the capsule is not of the right type, then
 * a null expression is returned (as checked via mlirAffineExprIsNull). In such
 * a case, the Python APIs will have already set an error. */
static inline MlirAffineExpr mlirPythonCapsuleToAffineExpr(PyObject *capsule) {
  void *ptr = PyCapsule_GetPointer(capsule, MLIR_PYTHON_CAPSULE_AFFINE_EXPR);
  MlirAffineExpr expr = {ptr};

}

//===- Wrap.h - C API Utilities ---------------------------------*- C++ -*-===//
//
// Part of the LLVM Project, under the Apache License v2.0 with LLVM Exceptions.
// See https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt for license information.
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
//
// This file contains common definitions for wrapping opaque C++ pointers into
// C structures for the purpose of C API. This file should not be included from
// C++ code other than C API implementation nor from C code.
//
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#ifndef MLIR_CAPI_WRAP_H
#define MLIR_CAPI_WRAP_H

#include "mlir-c/IR.h"
#include "mlir/Support/LLVM.h"

//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
// Definitions of methods for non-owning structures used in C API.
//===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

#define DEFINE_C_API_PTR_METHODS(name, cpptype)                                \
  static inline name wrap(cpptype *cpp) { return name{cpp}; }                  \
  static inline cpptype *unwrap(name c) {                                      \
    return static_cast<cpptype *>(c.ptr);                                      \
  }

#define DEFINE_C_API_METHODS(name, cpptype)                                    \
  static inline name wrap(cpptype cpp) {                                       \
    return name{cpp.getAsOpaquePointer()};                                     \
  }                                                                            \
  static inline cpptype unwrap(name c) {                                       \
    return cpptype::getFromOpaquePointer(c.ptr);                               \
  }

template <typename CppTy, typename CTy>
llvm::ArrayRef<CppTy> unwrapList(size_t size, CTy *first,
                                 llvm::SmallVectorImpl<CppTy> &storage) {
  static_assert(
      std::is_same<decltype(unwrap(std::declval<CTy>())), CppTy>::value,
      "incompatible C and C++ types");

  if (size == 0)
    return {};

  assert(storage.empty() && "expected to populate storage");
  storage.reserve(size);
  for (size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
    storage.push_back(unwrap(*(first + i)));
  return storage;
}

#endif // MLIR_CAPI_WRAP_H

"""MLIR bindings used by :mod:`max.graph`, plus Modular dialect registration.

Re-exports the MLIR Python binding objects (``Context``, ``Operation``,
``Module``, and friends). :func:`site_initialize` registers MAX's custom
dialects with MLIR and runs when the module is imported.
"""

from .._mlir._mlir_libs._mlir.ir import (
    ArrayAttr,
    Attribute,
    Block,
    BoolAttr,
    Context,
    Diagnostic,
    DictAttr,
    FunctionType,
    IndexType,
    InsertionPoint,
    IntegerAttr,
    Location,
    MLIRError,
    Module,
    Operation,
    OpView,
    StringAttr,
    Type,
    TypeAttr,
    Value,
)


def site_initialize() -> None:
    """Registers MAX's custom MLIR dialects with the global registry.

    Runs automatically when :mod:`max.mlir` is imported.
    """
    from max._core import graph  # type: ignore[import-not-found]

    # This ignore is needed externally but not internally
    from .._mlir._mlir_libs import (  # type: ignore[attr-defined, unused-ignore]
        get_dialect_registry,
    )

    graph.load_modular_dialects(get_dialect_registry())


site_initialize()

# Licensed under the Apache License v2.0 with LLVM Exceptions.
# See https://llvm.org/LICENSE.txt for license information.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception

from contextlib import contextmanager
from typing import Any, Mapping, Sequence

import os

_this_dir = os.path.dirname(__file__)


def get_lib_dirs() -> Sequence[str]:
    """Gets the lib directory for linking to shared libraries.

    On some platforms, the package may need to be built specially to export
    development libraries.
    """
    return [_this_dir]


def get_include_dirs() -> Sequence[str]:
    """Gets the include directory for compiling against exported C libraries.

    Depending on how the package was build, development C libraries may or may
    not be present.
    """
    return [os.path.join(_this_dir, "include")]


# Perform Python level site initialization. This involves:
#   1. Attempting to load initializer modules, specific to the distribution.
#   2. Defining the concrete mlir.ir.Context that does site specific
#      initialization.
#   3. Registering container classes with their respective protocols.
#
# Aside from just being far more convenient to do this at the Python level,
# it is actually quite hard/impossible to have such __init__ hooks, given
# the pybind memory model (i.e. there is not a Python reference to the object
# in the scope of the base class __init__).
#
# For #1, we:
#   a. Probe for modules named '_mlirRegisterEverything' and
#     '_site_initialize_{i}', where 'i' is a number starting at zero and
#     proceeding so long as a module with the name is found.
#   b. If the module has a 'register_dialects' attribute, it will be called
#     immediately with a DialectRegistry to populate.
#   c. If the module has a 'context_init_hook', it will be added to a list
#     of callbacks that are invoked as the last step of Context
#     initialization (and passed the Context under construction).
#   d. If the module has a 'disable_multithreading' attribute, it will be
#     taken as a boolean. If it is True for any initializer, then the
#     default behavior of enabling multithreading on the context
#     will be suppressed. This complies with the original behavior of all
#     contexts being created with multithreading enabled while allowing
#     this behavior to be changed if needed (i.e. if a context_init_hook
#     explicitly sets up multithreading).
#
# This facility allows downstreams to customize Context creation to their
# needs.

_dialect_registry = None
_load_on_create_dialects = None


def get_dialect_registry():
    global _dialect_registry

    if _dialect_registry is None:
        from ._mlir import ir

        _dialect_registry = ir.DialectRegistry()

    return _dialect_registry


def append_load_on_create_dialect(dialect: str):
    global _load_on_create_dialects
    if _load_on_create_dialects is None:
        _load_on_create_dialects = [dialect]
    else:
        _load_on_create_dialects.append(dialect)


def get_load_on_create_dialects():
    global _load_on_create_dialects
    if _load_on_create_dialects is None:
        _load_on_create_dialects = []
    return _load_on_create_dialects


def _site_initialize():
    import importlib
    import itertools
    import logging
    from ._mlir import ir

    logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    post_init_hooks = []
    disable_multithreading = False
    # This flag disables eagerly loading all dialects. Eagerly loading is often
    # not the desired behavior (see
    # https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/56037), and the logic is that
    # if any module has this attribute set, then we don't load all (e.g., it's
    # being used in a solution where the loading is controlled).
    disable_load_all_available_dialects = False

    def process_initializer_module(module_name):
        nonlocal disable_multithreading
        nonlocal disable_load_all_available_dialects
        try:
            m = importlib.import_module(f".{module_name}", __name__)
        except ModuleNotFoundError:
            return False
        except ImportError:
            message = (
                f"Error importing mlir initializer {module_name}. This may "
                "happen in unclean incremental builds but is likely a real bug if "
                "encountered otherwise and the MLIR Python API may not function."
            )
            logger.warning(message, exc_info=True)
            return False

        logger.debug("Initializing MLIR with module: %s", module_name)
        if hasattr(m, "register_dialects"):
            logger.debug("Registering dialects from initializer %r", m)
            m.register_dialects(get_dialect_registry())
        if hasattr(m, "context_init_hook"):
            logger.debug("Adding context init hook from %r", m)
            post_init_hooks.append(m.context_init_hook)
        if hasattr(m, "disable_multithreading"):
            if bool(m.disable_multithreading):
                logger.debug("Disabling multi-threading for context")
                disable_multithreading = True
        if hasattr(m, "disable_load_all_available_dialects"):
            disable_load_all_available_dialects = True
        return True

    # If _mlirRegisterEverything is built, then include it as an initializer
    # module.
    init_module = None
    if process_initializer_module("_mlirRegisterEverything"):
        init_module = importlib.import_module(f"._mlirRegisterEverything", __name__)

    # Load all _site_initialize_{i} modules, where 'i' is a number starting
    # at 0.
    for i in itertools.count():
        module_name = f"_site_initialize_{i}"
        if not process_initializer_module(module_name):
            break

    ir._Context = ir.Context

    class Context(ir._Context):
        def __init__(
            self, load_on_create_dialects=None, thread_pool=None, *args, **kwargs
        ):
            super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
            self.append_dialect_registry(get_dialect_registry())
            for hook in post_init_hooks:
                hook(self)
            if disable_multithreading and thread_pool is not None:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Context constructor has given thread_pool argument, "
                    "but disable_multithreading flag is True. "
                    "Please, set thread_pool argument to None or "
                    "set disable_multithreading flag to False."
                )
            if not disable_multithreading:
                if thread_pool is None:
                    self.enable_multithreading(True)
                else:
                    self.set_thread_pool(thread_pool)
            if load_on_create_dialects is not None:
                logger.debug(
                    "Loading all dialects from load_on_create_dialects arg %r",
                    load_on_create_dialects,
                )
                for dialect in load_on_create_dialects:
                    # This triggers loading the dialect into the context.
                    _ = self.dialects[dialect]
            else:
                if disable_load_all_available_dialects:
                    dialects = get_load_on_create_dialects()
                    if dialects:
                        logger.debug(
                            "Loading all dialects from global load_on_create_dialects %r",
                            dialects,
                        )
                        for dialect in dialects:
                            # This triggers loading the dialect into the context.
                            _ = self.dialects[dialect]
                else:
                    logger.debug("Loading all available dialects")
                    self.load_all_available_dialects()
            if init_module:
                logger.debug(
                    "Registering translations from initializer %r", init_module
                )
                init_module.register_llvm_translations(self)

        @contextmanager
        def transient_scope(self):
            """Context manager that begins a transient scope and ends it on exit.

            All types, attributes, affine expressions, and unregistered operations
            allocated within this scope will be rolled back upon exit. Any Python
            objects referencing transient IR entities must not be accessed after
            exiting this context manager.
            """
            self.begin_transient_scope()
            try:
                yield self
            finally:
                self.end_transient_scope()

    ir.Context = Context

    # Register containers as Sequences, so they can be used with `match`.

    Sequence.register(ir.BlockArgumentList)
    Sequence.register(ir.BlockList)
    Sequence.register(ir.BlockSuccessors)
    Sequence.register(ir.BlockPredecessors)
    Sequence.register(ir.OperationList)
    Sequence.register(ir.OpOperandList)
    Sequence.register(ir.OpOperands)
    Sequence.register(ir.OpResultList)
    Sequence.register(ir.OpSuccessors)
    Sequence.register(ir.RegionSequence)
    Mapping.register(ir.OpAttributeMap)


_site_initialize()

// Backs Graph profile scope's _location() wrap loop: wraps `child` in a
// MOGG::ProfileScopeLocationAttr naming the active scope.
MlirLocation profile_scope_location(MlirContext ctx, const std::string &name,
                                    MlirLocation child,
                                    std::optional<std::string> color);

namespace nb = nanobind;
using namespace M::Graph;

// For named argument shorthand.
// See:
// https://nanobind.readthedocs.io/en/stable/basics.html#keyword-and-default-arguments
using namespace nanobind::literals;

namespace {
void load_modular_dialects(MlirDialectRegistry registry) {
  M::MO::loadDialects(*unwrap(registry));
}

MlirOperation next_operation(MlirOperation op) {
  mlir::Operation *x = unwrap(op);
  return wrap(x->getNextNode());
}

MlirOperation prev_operation(MlirOperation op) {
  mlir::Operation *x = unwrap(op);
  return wrap(x->getPrevNode());
}

MlirOperation last_operation(MlirBlock block) {
  mlir::Block *x = unwrap(block);

  if (x->empty())
    return wrap((mlir::Operation *)nullptr);
  return wrap(&x->back());
}

/// Initializes M::Context when no global context exists, then registers it on
/// the given MLIR context so loadContext() succeeds for graph compilation and
/// kernel analysis.
///
/// Reuses the existing global M::Context when present (e.g. after
/// InferenceSession) if Init::Options match; otherwise creates it via
/// Init::getOrCreateContext with cpuDevice options aligned with
/// Engine::Context::create's default session (see comments in-body).
static void _init_and_register_max_context(MlirContext mlirCtx) {
  M::Init::Options options;
  M::AsyncRT::CPUDeviceOptions rtOptions;
  // AsyncRT::CPUDeviceOptions defaults mainWillDonate to true; Engine's
  // getOrCreateCPUDeviceOptions forces false.
  rtOptions.mainWillDonate = false;
  options.withCPUDeviceOptions(rtOptions);
  // Engine::Config defaults isCrashLogEnabled() to false;
  // Engine::Context::create passes withForceDisableCrashReporting(!that).
  options.withForceDisableCrashReporting(true);

  auto ctxOr = M::Init::getOrCreateContext("max-graph", options);
  if (ctxOr.isError())
    throw std::runtime_error(ctxOr.takeError().get());
  M::ContextRef maxContext = ctxOr.takeValue();

  M::registerContext(*unwrap(mlirCtx), maxContext);
}

M::ArrayElementsAttr array_attr(M::Driver::Python::Buffer &buffer,
                                M::MO::TensorType &type) {
  // Create an ND array from data, taking the size and shape from the tensor
  // type argument.
  auto spec = buffer.getSpec();

  llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t> bytesArray(llvm::bit_cast<uint8_t *>(buffer.data()),
                                     spec.getSizeInBytes());

  auto dims = llvm::SmallVector<int64_t>(spec.begin(), spec.end());
  auto shapedType =
      mlir::RankedTensorType::get(type.getIntDims(), type.getElementType());

  return M::ArrayElementsAttr::get({bytesArray.data(), bytesArray.size()},
                                   shapedType);
}

char *frame_traceback(void *frame_ptr) {
  // This is simply
  // `''.join(traceback.format_list(frame))`
  nb::gil_scoped_acquire acquire{};
  auto frame = nb::handle(reinterpret_cast<PyObject *>(frame_ptr));
  nb::object os = nb::module_::import_("traceback");
  nb::object formatStack = os.attr("format_list");
  auto empty = nb::str("");
  nb::object emptyJoin = empty.attr("join");

  auto outStr = nb::cast<std::string>(emptyJoin(formatStack(frame)));

  char *out = new char[outStr.size() + 1]{};
  // Copy to a string owned by the caller.
  outStr.copy(out, outStr.size());
  return out;
}

void frame_decref(void *frame_ptr) {
  // Destruction is always on the main thread controlled by python.
  // It will always have the gil.
  auto frame = nb::handle(reinterpret_cast<PyObject *>(frame_ptr));
  frame.dec_ref();
}

void frame_incref(void *frame_ptr) {
  // Destruction is always on the main thread controlled by python.
  // It will always have the gil.
  auto frame = nb::handle(reinterpret_cast<PyObject *>(frame_ptr));
  frame.inc_ref();
}

MlirLocation frame_loc(MlirContext ctx, nb::handle frame) {
  // The resulting location handles incrementing and decrementing the object's
  // reference count, as the object will be interned on the MLIR context.
  mlir::Location loc = M::RMO::PythonFrameAttr::getOpaque(
      unwrap(ctx), {.ptr = frame.ptr(),
                    .to_str = &frame_traceback,
                    .incref = &frame_incref,
                    .decref = &frame_decref});
  return wrap(loc);
}

// Serializes op and its descendants to MLIR bytecode with each op's
// Python-frame source location spelled out. The frames are attached as
// OpaqueLocs that hold a live callback and do not survive serialization, so
// they are materialized into serializable FusedLocs first. The materialization
// runs on a clone, so the caller's operation keeps its live OpaqueLocs.
//
// Bytecode rather than assembly text because this extension static-links its
// own LLVM: its textual float printer matches APFloat semantics by pointer
// against its own copy of the APFloatBase::sem* statics, so it mangles f64
// constants and aborts on any f32 that MLIR spells as a hex literal. Callers
// reparse this through max.mlir, which shares libmax's copy, and print there.
// See GEX-4052.
nb::bytes source_locations_bytecode(mlir::OpState &op) {
  mlir::OwningOpRef<mlir::Operation *> clone(op.getOperation()->clone());
  M::RMO::materializePythonFrameLocations(clone.get());
  std::string result;
  llvm::raw_string_ostream os(result);
  if (mlir::failed(mlir::writeBytecodeToFile(clone.get(), os)))
    throw std::runtime_error(
        "Failed to serialize operation with source locations to bytecode");
  return nb::bytes(result.data(), result.size());
}

/// Creates a Buffer directly from an MLIR constant attribute.
///
/// Supports:
/// - ArrayElementsAttr (#M.dense_array)
/// - AlignedBytesAttr (#M.aligned_bytes)
/// - DenseResourceElementsAttr (external blob)
///
/// Always copies data into a new buffer. Handles splatting when source
/// has 1 element but target shape requires more.
M::Driver::Python::Buffer
buffer_from_constant_attr(mlir::ElementsAttr attr, M::DType dtype,
                          const std::vector<size_t> &shape,
                          M::Driver::Python::PyDeviceTy device) {
  // Extract raw bytes based on attribute type
  llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t> rawData;

  if (auto arrayAttr = llvm::dyn_cast<M::ArrayElementsAttr>(attr)) {
    rawData = arrayAttr.getRawData();
  } else if (auto alignedAttr = llvm::dyn_cast<M::AlignedBytesAttr>(attr)) {
    rawData = alignedAttr.getData();
  } else if (auto denseResource =
                 llvm::dyn_cast<mlir::DenseResourceElementsAttr>(attr)) {
    auto blob = denseResource.getRawHandle().getBlob();
    if (!blob)
      throw std::runtime_error("DenseResourceElementsAttr has no blob data");
    auto blobData = blob->getData();
    rawData = llvm::ArrayRef<uint8_t>(
        reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(blobData.data()), blobData.size());
  } else {
    throw std::runtime_error(
        "Unsupported constant attribute type for buffer creation");
  }

  // Calculate element counts
  size_t targetNumElements = 1;
  for (size_t dim : shape)
    targetNumElements *= dim;

  size_t elementSize = dtype.getSizeInBytes();
  size_t srcNumElements = rawData.size() / elementSize;

  // Validate for splatting
  if (srcNumElements != targetNumElements && srcNumElements != 1) {
    throw std::runtime_error(
        "Invalid constant: source has " + std::to_string(srcNumElements) +
        " elements but target has " + std::to_string(targetNumElements) +
        " elements (not a splat)");
  }

  // TODO(MXF-106): use Buffer.frombuffer when available.
  // Create buffer and copy data
  M::Driver::Python::Buffer buffer(dtype, shape, device);
  uint8_t *dstData = static_cast<uint8_t *>(buffer.data());

  if (srcNumElements == targetNumElements) {
    // Direct copy
    std::memcpy(dstData, rawData.data(), rawData.size());
  } else {
    // Splat: replicate single element
    for (size_t i = 0; i < targetNumElements; ++i) {
      std::memcpy(dstData + i * elementSize, rawData.data(), elementSize);
    }
  }

  return buffer;
}

} // namespace

void M::Graph::Python::bindGraphModule(nb::module_ m) {
  m.doc() = R"nbdoc(
        Provides Python bindings for the MAX Graph API.
    )nbdoc";

  /// Attribute factories

  /// Register dialects needed to build MAX graphs.
  m.def("load_modular_dialects", &load_modular_dialects,
        "Registers all Modular MLIR dialects into the given registry.");

  /// Creates an array attribute from any Python object that implements the
  /// buffer protocol.
  /// Copies the buffer data into the array attribute interned into the
  /// MLIRContext.
  m.def("array_attr", &array_attr,
        "Creates an array attribute from a buffer and tensor type.");

  /// Creates a Buffer from an MLIR constant attribute (inverse of array_attr).
  /// Copies data and handles splatting.
  m.def("_buffer_from_constant_attr", &buffer_from_constant_attr,
        nb::arg("attr"), nb::arg("dtype"), nb::arg("shape"), nb::arg("device"),
        "Creates a Buffer from an MLIR constant attribute.");

  m.def("next_operation", &next_operation,
        "Returns the next operation in the parent block, or ``None``.");
  m.def("prev_operation", &prev_operation,
        "Returns the previous operation in the parent block, or ``None``.");
  m.def("last_operation", &last_operation,
        "Returns the last operation in the given block, or ``None``.");

  /// Converts a dtype to an MLIR type.
  m.def("dtype_to_type",
        infer_context(+[](mlir::MLIRContext *ctx, M::DType dtype) {
          auto mlirType = M::MO::toMLIRType(ctx, dtype);
          if (mlirType.isError())
            throw std::runtime_error("Invalid dtype");
          return *mlirType;
        }),
        "Converts a MAX :class:`DType` to the corresponding MLIR type.");

  m.def(
      "type_to_dtype",
      [](mlir::Type dtype) -> M::DType {
        ErrorOr<DType> type = M::MO::fromMLIRType(dtype);
        if (type.isError())
          throw std::runtime_error("Invalid type");
        return *type;
      },
      "Converts an MLIR type to the corresponding MAX :class:`DType`.");

  /// Creates an opaque location containing a python frame.
  m.def("frame_loc", &frame_loc,
        "Creates an opaque MLIR location containing a Python stack frame.");

  m.def("profile_scope_location", &profile_scope_location, "ctx"_a, "name"_a,
        "child"_a, "color"_a = std::nullopt,
        "Wraps `child` in a MOGG::ProfileScopeLocationAttr naming the active "
        "Graph.profile_scope(), with an optional color.");

  /// Serializes an operation to MLIR bytecode with Python source locations
  /// materialized, so a graph dumped without compiling it still shows where
  /// each op was built. Does not mutate the operation.
  m.def("source_locations_bytecode", &source_locations_bytecode, "op"_a,
        "Serializes the operation to MLIR bytecode with each op's Python "
        "source location materialized into printable form. Print it by "
        "reparsing through max.mlir. Does not mutate the operation.");

  m.def("_init_and_register_max_context", &_init_and_register_max_context,
        "mlir_ctx"_a,
        R"nbdoc(
      Initializes a process-wide M::Context when none exists, then registers it with the given MLIR context so compiler code can use loadContext.

      Internal API; does not expose M::Context to Python. New contexts are
      created via Init::getOrCreateContext (same Init path the Engine uses before
      attaching devices).
  )nbdoc");

  //===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//
  // KernelLibrary (backed by `mogg.kernel.decl` / `mogg.primitive.decl` ops)
  //===----------------------------------------------------------------------===//

  nb::class_<Python::KernelTorchInfo>(m, "KernelTorchInfo", R"nbdoc(
      The info needed to register a Mojo kernel as a PyTorch custom op.

      Built by :obj:`max.experimental.torch` from the kernel's ``execute``
      signature via ``KernelDeclAdaptor``.
  )nbdoc")
      .def_ro("num_dps_outputs", &Python::KernelTorchInfo::numDpsOutputs,
              "The number of leading destination-passing-style output "
              "arguments.")
      .def_ro("tensor_arg_names", &Python::KernelTorchInfo::tensorArgNames,
              "The source names of tensor-like arguments in declaration "
              "order (DPS outputs first, then inputs).");

  nb::class_<Python::Analysis>(m, "Analysis", R"nbdoc(
      Analyzes Mojo kernel libraries for custom operator integration.

      Loads one or more Mojo shared libraries and exposes their exported
      kernel operations for use in MAX graphs. Used internally to validate
      and register custom operations.

      Args:
          context: A Mojo library object or path.
          paths: The additional library search paths.
  )nbdoc")
      .def(nb::init<nb::object, std::vector<std::filesystem::path>>(),
           "context"_a, "paths"_a)
      .def_prop_ro("symbol_names", &Analysis::symbolNames,
                   "The list of exported kernel symbol names.")
      .def_prop_ro("library_paths", &Analysis::libraryPaths,
                   "The paths of all loaded libraries.")
      .def(
          "kernel",
          [](Analysis *self, const std::string &name) {
            return M::Graph::Python::castOp(self->kernelOp(name));
          },
          "Returns the MLIR operation for the named kernel symbol.")
      .def("verify_custom_op", &Analysis::verifyCustomOp,
           "Verifies that an operation matches the expected kernel signature.")
      .def("add_path", &Analysis::addPath,
           "Adds a library search path to this analysis.")
      .def("seed_kernel_decls", &Analysis::seedKernelDecls,
           "Copies kernel decl ops and the opaque-type mapping attribute "
           "into the given target module. Called by the compile path to "
           "seed a model module so the GC pipeline can skip "
           "``mogg-import-packages``.")
      .def("kernel_torch_info", &Analysis::kernelTorchInfo, "name"_a,
           "Returns the :class:`KernelTorchInfo` that "
           ":obj:`max.experimental.torch` needs to register the named kernel "
           "as a PyTorch custom op. Raises ``ValueError`` if the kernel is "
           "unknown or has an unsupported argument type.")
      .def("has_shape_function", &Analysis::hasShapeFunction, "name"_a,
           "Returns true if a shape function is registered for the named "
           "kernel.");

  M::Profiler::Python::addTracingToNanobindModuleClassMethods(
      m, "max._core.graph.");
}

MlirLocation profile_scope_location(MlirContext ctx, const std::string &name,
                                    MlirLocation child,
                                    std::optional<std::string> color) {
  mlir::MLIRContext *ctxPtr = unwrap(ctx);
  mlir::StringAttr colorAttr =
      color ? mlir::StringAttr::get(ctxPtr, *color) : mlir::StringAttr();
  mlir::Location loc = M::MOGG::ProfileScopeLocationAttr::get(
      ctxPtr, mlir::StringAttr::get(ctxPtr, name), unwrap(child), colorAttr);
  return wrap(loc);
}

using namespace M;
using namespace MO;

void M::MO::loadDialects(mlir::DialectRegistry &registry) {
  registry.insert<MO::MODialect, MOSH::MOSHDialect, MOGG::MOGGDialect,
                  MGP::MGPDialect, GRT::GRTDialect, RMO::RMODialect,
                  MAP::MAPDialect>();
  M::registerAllKGENDialects(registry);
  M::registerKGENToLLVMTranslation(registry);
}

void M::MO::registerShapeInferencePipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<>(
      "mo-shape-inference", "Run the end-to-end shape inference pipeline.",
      buildShapeInferencePipeline);
}

void M::MO::buildJitPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm) {
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLowerCompiledRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createInlineMGPCallsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createFixupOverhangsPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createOutlineModelsToCallables());
}

namespace {
static void gcPipelineImpl(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts, bool skipJit,
                           bool dumpIntermediates = false);
} // namespace

void M::MO::registerGCPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<GCPipelineOptions>(
      "gc-pipeline", "Full graph-compiler pipeline (MO → MGP → JIT).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
        // Enable dumps here so buildGCPipeline stays dump-free for cache keys.
        gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/false,
                       /*dumpIntermediates=*/!getMaxIRDumpDir().empty());
      });
}

void M::MO::registerGCPipelineThroughEmitMojo() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<GCPipelineOptions>(
      "gc-pipeline-pre-jit",
      "Graph compiler through emit-mojo (MO → MGP → emit-mojo; no JIT).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
        gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/true,
                       /*dumpIntermediates=*/!getMaxIRDumpDir().empty());
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMoPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MoPipelineOptions>(
      "mo-pipeline",
      "Passes from graph input up to (but not including) mo-to-mogg.",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MoPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMoPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMapPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MapPipelineOptions>(
      "map-pipeline",
      "Passes between mo-to-map and mogg-to-mgp (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MapPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMapPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMoggPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MoggPipelineOptions>(
      "mogg-pipeline",
      "Passes between mo-to-mogg and mogg-to-mgp (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MoggPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMoggPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerMgpPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<MgpPipelineOptions>(
      "mgp-pipeline", "Passes between mogg-to-mgp and jit (both excluded).",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm, const MgpPipelineOptions &opts) {
        buildMgpPipeline(pm, opts);
      });
}

void M::MO::registerJitPipeline() {
  mlir::PassPipelineRegistration<>(
      "jit-pipeline", "Passes that run after the jit pass.",
      [](mlir::OpPassManager &pm) { buildJitPipeline(pm); });
}

void M::MO::registerPasses() {
  MO::registerShapeInferencePipeline();
  MO::registerGCPipeline();
  MO::registerGCPipelineThroughEmitMojo();
  MO::registerMoPipeline();
  MO::registerMapPipeline();
  MO::registerMoggPipeline();
  MO::registerMgpPipeline();
  MO::registerJitPipeline();
  MO::registerMOToMAPPasses();
  MO::registerMOTransformsPasses();
  MAP::registerMAPTransformsPasses();
  MAP::registerMAPToMOGGPasses();
  MOGG::registerOutlineRoutinesPass();
  MGP::registerMOGGToMGP();

  MOGG::registerCanonicalizeFuncsForMerge();
  MOGG::registerMergeIdenticalFuncs();
  MOGG::registerAddProfileScopeTracingPass();
  MOGG::registerWrapFuncsWithTracePass();
  MOGG::registerAddTryExceptBlocksPass();
  MOGG::registerLookupConstantResources();
  MGP::registerRaiseBackIndexConstant();
  MOGG::registerOutlineAsyncRoutinesPass();
  MOGG::registerEmitMojo();
  MOGG::registerDumpMojo();
  MOGG::registerLoadMojo();
  MOGG::registerLowerCompiledRoutines();
  MGP::registerLowerPrimitives();
  MOGG::registerSequenceFusion();

  MGP::registerMGPTransformsPasses();
  MOGG::registerPasses();

  RMO::registerLegalizeRMOOpsPass();

  mlir::registerCSEPass();
  mlir::registerCanonicalizerPass();
  mlir::registerReconcileUnrealizedCastsPassPass();
  mlir::registerSCCPPass();
  mlir::registerSymbolDCEPass();
  mlir::registerViewOpGraphPass();

  KGEN::registerVerifyParametersPass();
}

LogicalResult MO::runGcPipeline(ModuleOp module,
                                const GCPipelineOptions &gcPipelineOptions) {

  mlir::PassManager pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      module.getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);

  if (!gcPipelineOptions.mlirTimingOutDir.empty()) {
    const char *pipelineName = "GC Pipeline";
    auto enabledTiming = M::configureMLIRPassTimingJSONOutput(
        pm, gcPipelineOptions.mlirTimingOutDir.getValue(), pipelineName);
    if (enabledTiming.isError()) {
      llvm::errs() << enabledTiming.getError() << "\n";
      return failure();
    }
  }

  MO::buildGCPipeline(pm, gcPipelineOptions);
  return pm.run(module);
}

void M::MO::buildMoPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                            const MoPipelineOptions &opts) {
  auto kernelLibraryPaths =
      llvm::to_vector_of<std::string>(opts.kernelLibraryPaths);

  // Skipped when the caller already seeded decls and
  // `mogg.opaque_type_mapping` via `MOGG::copyKernelDecls`. RewriteOpaqueTypes
  // still runs so freshly-cloned `!mo.opaque<"simple">` uses get rewritten.
  if (!opts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated) {
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createImportPackages(
        {.mojoPkgPaths = kernelLibraryPaths, .litMlirPaths = {}}));
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createVerifyKernels());
  }

  pm.addPass(MOGG::createRewriteOpaqueTypes());
  pm.addPass(KGEN::createVerifyParameters());

  if (opts.debugPrintAllTensors)
    pm.addPass(MO::createDebugPrintAllTensorsPass());

  pm.addPass(RMO::createLegalizeRMOOps());

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MO::createCanonicalizeChainSequences());

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  std::string_view compiledFrameworkLabel;
  if (opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.hasValue())
    compiledFrameworkLabel = opts.compiledFrameworkLabel;

  std::optional<std::string> cacheDir;
  if (opts.cacheDir.hasValue())
    cacheDir = opts.cacheDir;

  if (opts.useShapeInference)
    buildShapeInferencePipeline(pm);

  // TODO(GEX-886): Remove symbolic optimization's dependency on constant
  // folding.
  if (opts.constantFold)
    pm.addPass(MO::createConstantFoldPass(compiledFrameworkLabel, cacheDir,
                                          kernelLibraryPaths));

  pm.addPass(MO::createHoistConstantSubgraphsIntoParent());
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  SymbolicOptimizationOptions symbolicOptimizationOpts;
  symbolicOptimizationOpts.symbolicFfastMath = opts.symbolicFfastMath;
  symbolicOptimizationOpts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath =
      opts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath;

  pm.addPass(MO::createSymbolicOptimization(symbolicOptimizationOpts));
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  pm.addPass(MO::createMergeDuplicateShapeMaterializations());
  pm.addPass(MO::createAddFallbackShapeFunctions());
  pm.addPass(MO::createSymbolicOptimization(symbolicOptimizationOpts));
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  if (opts.constantFold)
    pm.addPass(MO::createConstantFoldPass(compiledFrameworkLabel, cacheDir,
                                          kernelLibraryPaths));

  pm.addPass(MO::createInferLayouts());
  if (opts.usePatterns) {
    MOGG::PatternFusionOptions patternFusionOpts;
    patternFusionOpts.mhaAllowUnsafeBCast =
        opts.patternFusionMHAAllowUnsafeBCasts;
    patternFusionOpts.mhaAllowInternalReshape =
        opts.patternFusionMHAAllowInternalReshape;
    patternFusionOpts.enableMHAPattern = opts.patternFusionMHAEnable;
    patternFusionOpts.targetDevice = opts.defaultDeviceLabel;
    patternFusionOpts.targetDeviceId = opts.defaultDeviceId;
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createPatternFusion(patternFusionOpts));

    InvokeShapePackingFunctionsOptions shapeFuncOptions;
    shapeFuncOptions.sanityCheckShapeFuncs = opts.sanityCheckShapeFuncs;

    pm.addPass(MO::createInvokeShapePackingFunctions(shapeFuncOptions));
    pm.addPass(MO::createPropagateShapes());
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  }

  MO::ValidateDevicesPassOptions validateDevicesPassOpt;
  validateDevicesPassOpt.defaultDeviceTargetTriple =
      opts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple;
  validateDevicesPassOpt.defaultDeviceTargetArch = opts.defaultDeviceTargetArch;
  pm.addPass(MO::createValidateDevicesPass(validateDevicesPassOpt));

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  // Absorb per-device consumers of an mo.tensor.unbundle back into the
  // producing mo.parallel (canonicalize collapses bundle(unbundle(X)) to X) so
  // epilogue fusion sees a single kernel body.
  pm.addPass(MO::createCreateParallelFromUnbundle());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MO::createMergeAdjacentParallels());

  if (opts.constantFold)
    pm.addPass(MO::createConstantFoldPass(compiledFrameworkLabel, cacheDir,
                                          kernelLibraryPaths));

  if (opts.fuseJitKernels) {
    // Without fusion this can add extraneous copies.
    pm.addPass(MO::createElideRedundantMutableOps());
  }

  pm.addPass(MO::createHoistParameterExpressions());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MO::createRemoveUnusedOps());
}

void M::MO::buildMapPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                             const MapPipelineOptions &opts) {
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createFuseKernels());
  if (opts.fuseMutableLoadStore)
    pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createFuseMutableLoads());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  // After fusion settles, give every fused-output epilogue a real store pointer
  // (plus a pre-cast accumulation buffer for mixed-precision accumulation).
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createAllocateAccumulatingBuffers());

  // An unfused reshape has no MAPToMOGG lowering (its hoisted stride op isn't
  // LowerableToMOGGInterface yet), and an unfused contiguous slice can take the
  // zero-copy path. Raise both back before outlining commits to MAP.
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createRaiseBackContiguousViews());

  pm.addPass(MAP::createOutlineStructuredKernelBodies());
  // Uniques `map.iter.opaque` inputs and captures so the lowered kernel's
  // parameter list is minimal.
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(MAP::createLoopInvariantViewMotion());
  // CSE before canonicalize: two loads hoisting the same view create identical
  // stride ops; CSE must unify them so DedupeCapturingClosureCaptures can fold
  // the duplicate captures.
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
}

void M::MO::buildMoggPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                              const MoggPipelineOptions &) {
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLegalizeRowwiseKernels());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createConformCallOperands());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createOutlineRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createWrapFuncsWithTrace());

  // On the module, not GraphOp: the outlined stubs are its siblings.
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
}

void M::MO::buildMgpPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                             const MgpPipelineOptions &opts) {
  auto kernelLibraryPaths =
      llvm::to_vector_of<std::string>(opts.kernelLibraryPaths);

  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createConcatInPlacePass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createExecInvariantCodeMotionPass());

  // After ExecInvariantCodeMotion: buffer reuse can block hoisting.
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimpleBufferReusePass());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createDynamicMemoryPlanningPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createDeferAllocsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createVerifyModelArgumentsPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createPredicateAssertDependenciesPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  // Before any fusion.
  pm.addPass(MGP::createAttachPythonStackTraces());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createGlobalizeSlotIndicesPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  MGP::LowerPrimitivesOptions lowerPrimOpts;
  lowerPrimOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  lowerPrimOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
  pm.addPass(MGP::createLowerPrimitives(lowerPrimOpts));

  {
    pm.addPass(MGP::createStageDeviceGraphsPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createPartitionDeviceGraphCollectivePass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createComputeDeviceGraphDependenciesPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyDeviceGraphDependenciesPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createGenerateBuildGraphStubsPass());
    // Drop the dead launch context chain before finalization audits the
    // builder bridge's live users.
    pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
    pm.addPass(MGP::createFinalizeDeviceGraphsPass());
    pm.addPass(mlir::createReconcileUnrealizedCastsPass());
  }

  pm.addPass(MOGG::createSequenceFusion());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyChainsPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MGP::ModelOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createSimplifyExtendLifetimesPass());

  pm.addPass(MOGG::createOutlineAsyncRoutines());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLookupConstantResources());

  // Lifting slot-index constants into stub arguments lets kernels differing
  // only in those indices merge below.
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createLiftBufferCacheSlots());

  // The emitted Mojo reads neither device ids nor symbolic dim names, so
  // erasing them lets per-device and per-layer copies merge below.
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createCanonicalizeFuncsForMerge());

  // Stubs that differ only by a redundant op merge once it is gone.
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createMergeIdenticalFuncs());

  // index.constant emits fewer lines of Mojo than its lowered form.
  pm.addPass(MGP::createRaiseBackIndexConstant());

  pm.addPass(MGP::createFixupOverhangsPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MOGG::FuncOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());

  // Drop stubs orphaned by MergeIdenticalFuncs.
  pm.addPass(mlir::createSymbolDCEPass());

  // Before try/except wrapping: the begin/end Trace calls raise, and the
  // MGP-ABI entry point must not.
  if (opts.enableProfileScopeTracing) {
    MOGG::AddProfileScopeTracingOptions profileScopeOptions;
    profileScopeOptions.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled =
        opts.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled;
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createAddProfileScopeTracing(profileScopeOptions));
  }

  // Last, so it sees the final raising set; try/except around non-raising
  // code warns in the Mojo compiler.
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createAddTryExceptBlocks());

  MOGG::EmitMojoOptions emitMojoOptions;
  emitMojoOptions.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  emitMojoOptions.enableOpTraceComments = opts.enableOpTraceComments;
  emitMojoOptions.enableComputeLambdas = opts.enableComputeLambdas;
  emitMojoOptions.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs =
      opts.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs;
  pm.addPass(MOGG::createEmitMojo(emitMojoOptions));

  if (opts.dumpMojoText)
    pm.addPass(MOGG::createDumpMojo());
}

namespace {

/// Appends every gc-pipeline stage to `pm`. With `dumpIntermediates`, a
/// DumpStagePass runs before the first stage and after each one.
static void gcPipelineImpl(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts, bool skipJit,
                           bool dumpIntermediates) {

  auto kernelLibraryPaths =
      llvm::to_vector_of<std::string>(opts.kernelLibraryPaths);

  // Filled by the first ("mo") dump from the non-subgraph model names while
  // the GraphOps still exist; later dumps reuse it.
  auto dumpBaseName = std::make_shared<std::string>();

  if (dumpIntermediates)
    pm.addPass(MO::createDumpStagePass("mo", dumpBaseName));

  MoPipelineOptions moOpts;
  moOpts.debugPrintAllTensors = opts.debugPrintAllTensors;
  moOpts.useShapeInference = opts.useShapeInference;
  moOpts.constantFold = opts.constantFold;
  if (opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.hasValue())
    moOpts.compiledFrameworkLabel = opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.getValue();
  if (opts.cacheDir.hasValue())
    moOpts.cacheDir = opts.cacheDir.getValue();
  moOpts.symbolicFfastMath = opts.symbolicFfastMath;
  moOpts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath = opts.symbolicNoUndefinedMath;
  moOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  moOpts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated = opts.kernelDeclsPrePopulated;
  moOpts.usePatterns = opts.usePatterns;
  moOpts.patternFusionMHAEnable = opts.patternFusionMHAEnable;
  moOpts.patternFusionMHAAllowUnsafeBCasts =
      opts.patternFusionMHAAllowUnsafeBCasts;
  moOpts.patternFusionMHAAllowInternalReshape =
      opts.patternFusionMHAAllowInternalReshape;
  moOpts.sanityCheckShapeFuncs = opts.sanityCheckShapeFuncs;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceLabel = opts.defaultDeviceLabel;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceId = opts.defaultDeviceId;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple = opts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple;
  moOpts.defaultDeviceTargetArch = opts.defaultDeviceTargetArch;
  moOpts.fuseJitKernels = opts.fuseJitKernels;

  MapPipelineOptions mapOpts;
  mapOpts.fuseMutableLoadStore = opts.fuseMutableLoadStore;

  MoggPipelineOptions moggOpts;

  MGP::MOGGToMGPOptions moToPrimOpts;
  moToPrimOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
  if (opts.compiledFrameworkLabel.hasValue())
    moToPrimOpts.compiledFrameworkLabel = opts.compiledFrameworkLabel;

  MgpPipelineOptions mgpOpts;
  mgpOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
  mgpOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
  mgpOpts.enableOpTraceComments = opts.enableOpTraceComments;
  mgpOpts.enableComputeLambdas = opts.enableComputeLambdas;
  mgpOpts.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs = opts.moggDebugDumpFusedTensorSpecs;
  mgpOpts.dumpMojoText = opts.dumpMojoText;
  mgpOpts.enableProfileScopeTracing = opts.enableProfileScopeTracing;
  mgpOpts.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled =
      opts.profileScopeTracingTraceUnlabelled;

  MOGG::JitCompileKernelsOptions jitOpts;
  if (!skipJit) {
    jitOpts.minimumCpuAlignment = opts.minimumCpuAlignment;
    jitOpts.saveTempPrefix = opts.saveTempPrefix;
    jitOpts.createMOGGReproducers = opts.createMOGGReproducers;
    jitOpts.kernelLibraryPaths = kernelLibraryPaths;
    jitOpts.timeMOGGCompile = opts.timeMOGGCompile;
    jitOpts.debugKGENStubs = opts.debugKGENStubs;
    // Cross-compile for the requested GPU instead of probing the host.
    jitOpts.defaultDeviceTargetArch = opts.defaultDeviceTargetArch;
    jitOpts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple = opts.defaultDeviceTargetTriple;
    jitOpts.compileForHostExecution = opts.compileForHostExecution;
  }

  auto buildStage = [&](auto &&build, const std::string &dumpSuffix) {
    build(pm);
    if (dumpIntermediates && !dumpSuffix.empty())
      pm.addPass(MO::createDumpStagePass(dumpSuffix, dumpBaseName));
  };

  buildStage([&](auto &p) { buildMoPipeline(p, moOpts); }, "mo-pre-map");

  // Stable-tensor marking must see MO ops, so it runs as the last MO-level
  // pass before the dialect is lowered away.
  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        p.addPass(MO::createMarkStableTensorsPass());
        p.addPass(MO::createMOToMAP());
      },
      "mo-to-map");

  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        buildMapPipeline(p, mapOpts);
        // After MAP fusion so a check never fuses into the kernel it checks;
        // before map-to-mogg so the injected checks compile with the rest.
        if (opts.nanCheck)
          p.addPass(MO::createNanCheckPass(opts.nanCheckStride));
      },
      "map-pre-mogg");

  MAP::MAPToMOGGOptions mapToMoggOpts;
  mapToMoggOpts.enableComputeLambdas = opts.enableComputeLambdas;
  buildStage([&](auto &p) { p.addPass(MAP::createMAPToMOGG(mapToMoggOpts)); },
             "map-to-mogg");

  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        buildMoggPipeline(p, moggOpts);
        // OpaqueLoc tracebacks can't be printed, so convert them for the
        // dump. Dump-only: this strips the OpaqueLocs buildMgpPipeline's
        // assert handling reads.
        if (dumpIntermediates)
          p.addPass(MGP::createAttachPythonStackTraces());
      },
      "mogg-pre-mgp");

  buildStage([&](auto &p) { p.addPass(MGP::createMOGGToMGP(moToPrimOpts)); },
             "mogg-to-mgp");

  buildStage(
      [&](auto &p) {
        buildMgpPipeline(p, mgpOpts);
        if (!skipJit) {
          p.addPass(MOGG::createJitCompileKernels(jitOpts));
          p.addPass(MOGG::createStripKernelDecls());
          buildJitPipeline(p);
        }
      },
      "mgp");
}

} // namespace

void M::MO::buildGCPipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                            const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
  gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/false);
}

void M::MO::buildGCPipelineThroughEmitMojo(mlir::OpPassManager &pm,
                                           const GCPipelineOptions &opts) {
  gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/true);
}

LogicalResult M::MO::runGCPipeline(ModuleOp moduleOp,
                                   const GCPipelineOptions &opts,
                                   bool dumpIntermediates) {
  auto pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      moduleOp.getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);

  if (!opts.mlirTimingOutDir.empty()) {
    auto enabledTiming = M::configureMLIRPassTimingJSONOutput(
        pm, opts.mlirTimingOutDir.getValue(), "GC Pipeline");
    if (enabledTiming.isError()) {
      llvm::errs() << enabledTiming.getError() << "\n";
      return failure();
    }
  }

  gcPipelineImpl(pm, opts, /*skipJit=*/opts.preJit, dumpIntermediates);
  return pm.run(moduleOp);
}

void M::MO::buildShapeInferencePipeline(mlir::OpPassManager &pm) {
  // Turns static reshapes like `[D0] -> [1]` into rebinds (so staticization
  // needn't look through them) and materializes parameter definitions for
  // `mo.rebind`s that still declare output parameters.
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());

  // Evaluates constant ops and shape functions in the parameter domain, then
  // simplifies parameter bindings by substitution and constraint solving.
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(MO::createPropagateShapes());
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCSEPass());
  pm.addNestedPass<MO::GraphOp>(mlir::createCanonicalizerPass());
  pm.addPass(KGEN::createVerifyParameters());
}

using BlobMap = DenseMap<const uint8_t *, mlir::AsmResourceBlob *>;

static BlobMap getDenseResources(ModuleOp module) {
  BlobMap result;
  for (Operation &op : module.getOps()) {
    if (auto modelOp = dyn_cast<MGP::ModelOp>(op)) {
      modelOp.walk([&](MGP::BufferConstantOp constOp) {
        auto elementsAttr = constOp.getValue();
        if (auto resourceAttr =
                dyn_cast<DenseResourceElementsAttr>(elementsAttr)) {
          mlir::AsmResourceBlob *blob = resourceAttr.getRawHandle().getBlob();
          if (blob->getDeleter())
            result[blob->getDataAs<uint8_t>().data()] = blob;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  return result;
}

ErrorOr<BufferRef> M::MO::convertMGPToMEF(ModuleOp module,
                                          bool enableMEFMetadata) {
  OwningOpRef<ModuleOp> moduleToRewrite = module.clone();
  // Device-generic ops get renamed with their device label so GraphRT can
  // dispatch to a device-appropriate primitive.
  BlobMap resources = getDenseResources(*moduleToRewrite);
  mlir::PassManager pm = mlir::PassManager::on<ModuleOp>(
      module->getContext(), mlir::OpPassManager::Nesting::Implicit);
  pm.addPass(MGP::createPrepareDevicePrimitivesPass());
  FormatScopedDiagnosticHandler diagnostics(moduleToRewrite->getContext());
  if (failed(pm.run(*moduleToRewrite)))
    return Error(Twine("Failed to prepare MGP model for conversion to MEF. ") +
                 diagnostics.formatMessage());
  ConcatenationTree result =
      translateMLIRToMEF(*moduleToRewrite, enableMEFMetadata);
  if (result.getSize() == 0) {
    return Error(Twine("Failed to convert model to MEF. ") +
                 diagnostics.formatMessage());
  }
  M::WriteableBufferRef outputBuffer = WriteableBuffer::get(
      0, maxAttributeAlignment().value(), result.getSize());
  result.traverse([&](ArrayRef<uint8_t> data) {
    outputBuffer->write(reinterpret_cast<const char *>(data.data()),
                        data.size());
    if (resources.count(data.data())) {
      if (auto blob = resources[data.data()]; blob->getDeleter()) {
        // Free owned blob data as soon as it's been copied out.
        auto ref = M::GML::BlobLifetimeManager(std::move(blob->getDeleter()),
                                               blob->getData(),
                                               blob->getDataAlignment());
        blob->getDeleter() = nullptr;
      }
    }
  });

  return outputBuffer;
}

using namespace mlir;
